info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Product Suggest Configurations API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: trackingId
params.description: Tracking ID of the product suggest configuration

items.docs:
Shows a Product suggest configuration in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"EDIT","targetId":"{trackingId}"} ```
